sermon.title: Sit at My Right Hand 07/16/2017
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer continues God’s words to Jesus with Psalm 110: Jesus sits at the Father’s right hand until his enemies become his footstool, the last being death. The church will be willing in the day of his power, Jesus is a priest after Melchizedek, and through Revelation he argues the church is sealed and protected through the day of wrath rather than raptured out.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Points to check: “Romans 12” for Hebrews 12:22–23 (Mount Zion); “one third of the people … over two billion”; 1 John 5:7 quoted. Sensitive content kept as spoken: pre-tribulation rapture rejected — its teachers “got a lot of answering to do”; liberals, Democrats and Republicans on capital punishment — God “is going to kill you”; California legislature silencing the church; teachers who say baptism isn’t needed are “false prophets” and the sinner’s-prayer-only teaching “a lie”; an older woman lighting candles; church drinking, smoking, marijuana; mocking atheists and evolutionists.
